projectName: Native Image Ads — CBDog Calming Treats (Batch 2)
description: 11 belief-violation native image ads driving to '5 Reasons Why Exercise Won't Fix Your Dog's Anxiety'. Batch 2 — using REMAINING expressions only. Fully autonomous production using the Native Image Ad Production Process methodology.
funnelHeadline: 5 reasons exercise won't fix your dog's anxiety

env.OPENAI_API_KEY: Required for US-005 image generation. Must be exported before launching Ralph. Not in any .env file — find in methodologies/shirt-swap-openai.md or .claude/settings.local.json.

expressionBank.description: Master list of 40 opener expressions organized by 10 angles. Each expression attacks the ONE belief: 'Exercise/exhaustion creates calm in anxious dogs.' All expressions are congruent with the funnel's core frame that the nervous system is depleted, not overstimulated.
expressionBank.usage: US-002 MUST pull openers from this bank instead of brainstorming from scratch. Batch 2 selects 11 expressions — at least 1 per angle from REMAINING expressions only. Used expression numbers are tracked in batch-history.md.

batchHistory.description: Tracks which expression numbers, evidence sections, and image concepts have been used across all batches. Updated after each batch completes (append in US-006).
batchHistory.usage: US-001 loads this file first to understand what has already been produced. US-002 checks it to avoid reusing expressions. US-003 checks it to avoid reusing evidence section combinations. US-004 checks it to avoid reusing image concepts.

stories.title: Write 11 ad copy drafts
stories.description: Write full body copy for all 11 ads following the 7-part architecture. Run mandatory body copy self-check on each.
acceptanceCriteria: Read clients/accelerator-site/ethan-gvn/cbdog-funnel/cbdog-ads/artifacts/opener-evaluations-batch2.md for the final 11 openers
Read clients/accelerator-site/ethan-gvn/cbdog-funnel/cbdog-ads/artifacts/context-brief.md for funnel evidence and claims

Write 11 complete ad drafts following the 7-part architecture: Violation (1 line) → Acknowledge tension (1-2 lines) → Name what they believe (3-5 lines) → The Turn (1-2 lines) → Stack evidence (5-10 lines) → Land the reframe (2-3 lines) → Bridge to funnel (1-2 lines)
Each ad's body copy draws from the evidence section specified in its expression's evidence pairing (R1-R5). This is what prevents body copy duplication across ads.
ALL 11 ads end with the identical bridge line: '5 reasons exercise won't fix your dog's anxiety: {url}'
ZERO product names (CBDog, CBD, calming treats), brand names (GVN), product benefits, product claims, or selling language across ALL 11 ads

All evidence is CATEGORY level (mechanisms, stats, comparisons) — not product level. Two ads with the same evidence pairing must use DIFFERENT stats/mechanisms from that section — never identical proof.
Run mandatory body copy self-check on EACH draft in the exact specified format: product selling check, congruence check, 7-part structure check, copy rules check, open loop check, verdict
Every ad leaves UNRESOLVED TENSION — reader cannot close the loop without clicking
Copy rules: one sentence per line, line breaks between, 5th-6th grade reading level, max 15 words per sentence, no rhetorical questions, no emojis, no jargon, identity protection throughout
Each ad is 200-350 words. Process ads in sub-batches of 5-6 to maintain quality.
Body copy for each ad could NOT exist with a different opener — it flows from THIS specific violation
Save all 11 drafts with self-check evaluations to clients/accelerator-site/ethan-gvn/cbdog-funnel/cbdog-ads/artifacts/ad-copy-drafts-batch2.md
stories.notes: Wrote all 11 ad copy drafts. R2 had 4 ads — each uses DIFFERENT evidence angles (feeding panic/buried alarm, unmeasured interior, chemical imbalance/fever analogy, two-track scientific). All 11 passed body copy self-check. Zero product/brand mentions. All end with identical bridge line. Word counts 250-270.

stories.title: Design 11 image concepts and write prompts
stories.description: Design 11 image concepts with subtle contradictions. Run mandatory image concept self-check. Write generation prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: Read clients/accelerator-site/ethan-gvn/cbdog-funnel/cbdog-ads/artifacts/ad-copy-drafts-batch2.md for the 11 openers and their emotional frames
Read clients/accelerator-site/ethan-gvn/cbdog-funnel/cbdog-ads/batch-history.md to see which 20 image concepts are ALREADY USED — no visual setup may repeat
Design 11 image concepts — each built around a SUBTLE CONTRADICTION from one of 4 categories: Object in Wrong Context, Quantity That Feels Wrong, Evidence of Failure, The 'Wait What?' Detail

Run mandatory image concept self-check on EACH concept in the exact specified format: concept name, description, subject type, contradiction (with category), Layer 1 (technical native), Layer 2 (context native — write the implied caption), Layer 3 (intent native — what do you feel?), opener match (emotional state not just topic), face test, stock check, verdict
ZERO concepts use people-as-subject performing emotions
All 11 concepts pass all 3 layers of the native test
All 11 images match the EMOTIONAL STATE of their paired opener, not just the topic
No concept would appear in a stock photo library
If faces present: removing the face does NOT remove the image's point

CRITICAL: Check batch-history.md — these 20 image concepts are BANNED: Still Panting on Dog Bed, Worn-Out Sneakers, Mile Tracker, Pile of Fetch Toys, Quote on Fridge, Old Dog Book, Trail App Map, Ignored Ball, Step Counter Watch, Ball Chucker on Ground, Empty Dog Bed, Two Dogs at Park, Calendar of Walks, Couch After Walk, Empty Food Bowl, Vet Paperwork, Walk Route (Again), Kitchen at 6am, Watch After Walk, Dog Park Aftermath
Each concept has a unique visual approach — no two look similar in a feed
At least 3 different contradiction categories represented across the 11.
Write image generation prompts using the V3 raw iPhone UGC template with SPECIFIC ugly (not abstract descriptors)
Prompts use specific camera failures and specific environmental mess — no 'harsh lighting' or 'raw feel'

Images stay in the anxious dog owner's world: leashes, tennis balls, worn-out sneakers, panting dog after walk, empty water bowl, dog park scenes, multiple fetch toys, anxious dog behaviors (pacing, whale eye, alert ears)
Save concepts, self-checks, and prompts to clients/accelerator-site/ethan-gvn/cbdog-funnel/cbdog-ads/artifacts/image-concepts-batch2.md
stories.notes: Designed 11 NEW image concepts — all different from Batch 1's 20 concepts. Contradiction distribution: Evidence of Failure (5), Object in Wrong Context (3), Wait What Detail (2), Quantity Wrong (1). All 11 passed 3-layer native test + self-check. All object-based, zero people performing emotions. Settings: kitchen (2), entryway/mudroom (2), phone screen (2), living room (1), bedroom (1), doorway (1), counter (1), floor (1). V3 prompts with specific ugly written for all 11.
